title: mxv/proxy-status/v1
description: Whether the proxy runs, its addresses and certificate authority, and each route that a workspace declares with the unit behind it.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

RouteRow.description: One route, as `mxv proxy status` prints it.

route.description: The route's name in the workspace's `routes`.

workspace.description: The workspace that declares the route.

url.description:
The URL that serves the route, or `(not served)` when another
workspace's name makes the same host label.

unit.description:
The process or container that listens on the route's port, or null
when no unit does.

state.description:
The state of the unit: `running`, `stopped`, and so on, or why the
route has no unit.

notes.description: One line under the route when it is not served.

ProxySummary.description: What `mxv proxy status` says above its rows.

running.description: Whether Caddy answers on the admin socket.

version.description: Caddy's version, or null when mxv could not tell.

authority.description:
`none` when Caddy has not made a certificate authority, `trusted`
or `untrusted` when this machine does or does not trust it, and
`unknown` when mxv cannot tell on this system.

routes.description: The number of routes that the proxy serves once it runs.

problems.description: One sentence for each record or manifest that mxv could not read.

AuthorityState.description: Whether this machine trusts the proxy's certificate authority.

oneOf.description: This machine does not trust it.
mxv cannot tell on this system.
